 LIVE UPDATES NFL Cleveland Browns vs. New Orleans Saints NFL Week 9 Live Updates, Highlights and Analysis
 Gary Davenport Nov 8, 2026, updated 7 min ago 
 Week 9 is a big one for the Cleveland Browns.
 As the Browns head to New Orleans to face the Saints, they do so coming off a lopsided loss to the Pittsburgh Steelers. With the Cincinnati Bengals having already won in Madrid, the Browns badly need a win to avoid falling farther off the pace in the AFC North.
 Getting that win won't be easy—quarterback Deshaun Watson cleared the concussion protocol, but after missing practice all week Cleveland head coach Todd Monken made the decision to go with Shedeur Sanders Sunday.
 Will the Browns get win No. 6 for the season? Or will the team find itself in its first losing streak of 2026?
 Keep it here for the answers to those questions and more, with highlights and analysis from this Big Easy brouhaha.
 Live Updates
 37 Total Posts
 Newest First ​ 7 mins ago 01:32 PM Perfect Overtiming
 Tight end Harold Fannin didn't have a catch in regulation.
 He made up for it in overtime.
 Browns going for two and the win.
 16 mins ago 01:23 PM Saints 23, Browns 16
 So, um, maybe the Browns should have taken the ball when they won the overtime coin toss.
 20 mins ago 01:18 PM Leaky Run D
 AP Photo/Gerald Herbert 
 Saints moving the ball on the first drive of OT--mainly on the ground.
 30 mins ago 01:09 PM Great Play
 If the Browns lose this game, it won't be because of Shedeur Sanders.
 Andre Szmyt cashes in from 51 yards out--and we're headed for overtime at 16 apiece.
 36 mins ago 01:02 PM Saints 16, Browns 13
 Those mistakes we referenced gave the Saints a short field. Tyler Shough hit Chris Olave on a long pass. And Audric Estime cashed it in from two yards out.
 Sigh.
 46 mins ago 12:52 PM Mistakes...Again
 Offensive holding.
 The fifth sack of the game.
 This is how teams lose.
 53 mins ago 12:46 PM PLEASE Run the Damn Ball
 AP Photo/Gerald Herbert 
 Browns force a three-and-out.
 4:17 to play. 
 Time to close this game out.
 57 mins ago 12:41 PM KC and the Sunshine Band
 So, um, KC Concepcion's ankle appears to be OK.
 The rookie's first career touchdown puts the Browns up 13-9.
 Oh yeah.
 1 hour ago 12:37 PM Hardened Steel
 After nearly jumping offside, nickel back Myles Harden logs his second sack of the game.
 Saints connect on a long field goal though.
 New Orleans 9, Cleveland 6--5:38 to go.
 1 hour ago 12:26 PM Fourth and Futility
 This play is called "The Remote Breaker."
 In that respect, at least, it worked.
 1 hour ago 12:22 PM Good News
 AP Photo/Gerald Herbert 
 Concepcion is back, making a catch that's good for a first down that gets Cleveland across midfield.
 1 hour ago 12:19 PM 15 Minutes to Go
 The third quarter closes with a Myles Harden sack, and the Browns force a punt.
 1 hour ago 12:13 PM This is...Not Good
 Three plays, -9 yards and another sack allowed.
 Cleveland has to punt, and rookie wideout KC Concepcion had to be helped off the field.
 1 hour ago 12:08 PM Browns 6, Saints 6
 New Orleans takes the ball 54 yards in 13 plays, but the Cleveland defense stiffens in the red-zone and forces a short field goal.
 We're all tied up--and nodding off from boredom.
 1 hour ago 12:00 PM Ole!
 That's, um...not a great look for a defender.
 1 hour ago 11:56 AM Do You Have a Receipt?
 AP Photo/Carolyn Kaster 
 The Browns spent big in free agency and the draft in an effort to rebuild the offensive line.
 What's the return policy on something like that. Cleveland leads the league in sacks allowed and entered Week 9 averaging under 98 yards per game on the ground. 
 1 hour ago 11:51 AM Browns 6, Saints 3
 The good news is that the Browns are winning.
 The bad news is they have been inside the Saints' five-yard line twice and have three points to show for it.
 1 hour ago 11:48 AM Boston!
 Now we're talking!
 1 hour ago 11:46 AM Scrambling Man
 Part of the reason for Cleveland's offensive struggles Sunday is that Shedeur Sanders is pulling the ball down at the first sign of pressure.
 We'll let him slide on this one.
 Or dive. Whatever.
 1 hour ago 11:41 AM The Defense Rests
 AP Photo/David Dermer 
 Tyler Shough tries to force the ball to Chris Olave, and slot corner Myles Harden nearly has Cleveland's third takeaway of the afternoon.
 Three and out. Ball back to the Browns.
 2 hours ago 11:34 AM A Dark Day
 It has been over three decades, and this still makes me want to hurl obscenities at the TV.
 2 hours ago 11:25 AM Intermission
 AP Photo/Gerald Herbert 
 As has been the case so often this season, Cleveland's defense is trying to keep the Browns in the game. But the offense has been offensive--just 80 total yards.
 Cleveland has to run the ball more in the second half--or they are absolutely going to lose this game.
 3-3 at the break.
 2 hours ago 11:20 AM Olave!
 That's twice the Browns have been cooked deep in this game.
 2 hours ago 11:14 AM My Head Hurts
 Bad first-down playcall.
 Bad fourth-down exchange.
 Bad football.
 No points.
 2 hours ago 11:09 AM Run the Damn Ball
 First and goal. Having some success running right at the Saints.
 So of course Todd Monken gets cute.
 Cute gets you beat.
 The next play? A 12-yard Quinshon Judkins run.
 2 hours ago 11:02 AM Fumble! (Again)
 A special play on special teams gives the Browns an instant red zone possession.
 2 hours ago 10:53 AM Fumble!
 The Browns entered Week 9 leading the league in forced fumbles, and there hasn't been a bigger one this season than the Carson Schwesinger punchout that ended the Saints' drive inside the Cleveland five-yard line.
 2 hours ago 10:50 AM Um...Oops
 Cleveland's coverage over the middle this season has been...bad.
 2 hours ago 10:47 AM Saints 3, Browns 3
 It wasn't especially pretty, but Cleveland turned good field position after a missed field goal into a nine-play, 35 yard drive that culminated in an Andre Szmyt kick from 41 yards out.
 3 hours ago 10:35 AM GAH!!!!
 AP Photo/Matt Rourke 
 Penalties have been an issue all season long--the Browns are the league's most-penalized team.
 Cleveland picked up six more in the first quarter. Six. 
 Sloppy. Unprofessional. Undisciplined.
 Unacceptable.
 Still 3-0 after 15 minutes. 
 3 hours ago 10:26 AM Heating Sanders Up
 AP Photo/Gerald Herbert 
 The Saints are blitzing the bejeezus out of Sanders.
 You would think that the Browns might want to lean on the run game with a young quarterback making his first start of the season.
 So of course Quinshon Judkins has one carry.
 At least the Browns aren't on pace to commit 20 penalties in the game.
 Oh wait. They totally are.
 3 hours ago 10:14 AM Saints 3, Browns 0
 Atrocious run defense against a practice squad call-up (and former Brown) Audric Estime.
 Abysmal tackling.
 Back-to-back offsides penalties.
 Cleveland's defense stiffened in the red zone, but the Saints are on the board first.
 3 hours ago 10:09 AM Not Ideal
 Tytus Howard gets his 137th false start of the season, Shedeur Sanders gets dropped on third down and Cleveland goes backward on their first drive.
 3 hours ago 10:05 AM Fashion Faux Pas
 We think they are hideous.
 That's what we think.
 3 hours ago 10:03 AM Fire Ryan Day!
 Figure there's more than a little crossover between Browns nation and Buckeye Nation.
 Plus I like to pander. Give the people what they want and all.
 3 hours ago 09:59 AM Trash Talk
 Shedeur Sanders' "comments" earlier this week have been played up as disrespectful. As bulletin board material.
 Apparently it's a slow week. Because this is a nothingburger.
 3 hours ago 09:47 AM A HYPE Video?
 Won't lie.
 This does not make me feel better about Sanders starting this week.
